verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is a law firm, but it ships client-facing software: the SCC and Term Sheet generators, a HighQ-hosted Deal Room, and a Legora-based AI assistant. Telemetry opt-out is therefore a fair question for those tools. Nothing in the evidence mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or opt-out controls for any of them. The privacy practice page describes legal advisory services, not product data-collection controls, so it does not count.
